projects.title: ScholarPilot
projects.description: • Built an AI multi-agent system that extracts and summarizes academic papers, providing metadata and key insights with an interactive context-aware QnA system using Groq API and RAG pipeline.• Awarded Best AI Agent Project at Columbia DevFest 2025, recognized for its ability to streamline research through intelligent agent collaboration and contextual retrieval, reducing topic-based paper tracking time by 30%.

projects.title: Vintage Tennis

projects.title: Multi-Dimensional Sentiment Analysis

projects.title: Coinventor

projects.title: Positive vs. Negative

projects.title: Vietnamese Fake News Detection Based on Tokenization from Pre-trained Models and Word Embeddings BiLSTM Model
